statement: In the controlled reference experiment, the project harness validates and executes one declared read_file call, records the successful tool result between two model turns, and produces the same normalized trace fingerprint across two repetitions.

display_text.zh-CN: 在受控参考实验中，项目 Harness 校验并执行一次声明过的 read_file 调用，在两次模型回合之间记录成功结果，并在两次重复运行中产生相同的规范化 Trace 指纹。
display_text.en: In the controlled reference experiment, the project harness validates and executes one declared read_file call, records the successful result between two model turns, and produces the same normalized trace fingerprint across two repetitions.

evidence.title: Reference tool roundtrip controlled run
evidence.notes: The scripted model and read-only fixture isolate the harness pipeline. This is not evidence about any vendor agent.

notes: The claim is intentionally limited to the committed controlled fixture, runner, and normalized trace output.
